column1: # Mercenary den activities (MERC-2, #84): the templates a den draws its
# "Mercenary Tactical Operations" (MTOs) from. Authored by us: every number
# and every dungeon pick is [A]. The client carries the SHAPE of a template
# (sovereignty/mercenaryden/client/data/activity.py: name and description
# message ids, a dungeon, a development impact, an anarchy impact, an infomorph
# bonus [V]) and no numbers; the server sends the client what is here. Read by
# the server (`merc_den::activity::TABLE`); edit and restart.
# template: a number that names the row; the order of the numbers is the order
#   a den's pick is made over.
# name_msg, description_msg: client localization message ids
#   (`localization.GetByMessageID`, jobboard/.../mercenary_tactical_operations/
#   job.py:37-38 [V]); the client's own MTO texts, picked by reading its
#   localization names UI/MercenaryDens/MTOText/MTOEncounter<N>Name and ...
#   Description. Keys only, no text.
# dungeon: the dungeon id the site runs, an archetype-31 dungeon of the bundle
#   with a name (the site opens as an escalation-shaped personal site; the
#   server drops a template whose dungeon is missing from the bundle or has no
#   text). The client's own MTO dungeons are not in the bundle, so each pick is
#   the nearest faction ladder rung [A].
# dev_impact, anarchy_impact: levels added to the den's development level and
#   to its anarchy level when the site is cleared (an anarchy impact is
#   negative: the site lowers it; neither level goes below 0).
# infomorph_bonus: infomorphs added to the den's hold on completion (up to its
#   cargo cap).
# duration_s: seconds a started activity stays open before it expires.
# why: the [A] and its falsifier.
